full_prompt_en: The image is a square oil-painting-like portrait of a black raven wearing an ornate crown against a worn olive-brown background. The backdrop is a shallow, nearly flat wall-like surface, with mottled stains, faint vertical marks and uneven warm grey patches. Across the top, the darker field provides a subdued setting for the crown's irregular pointed outline. The bird fills most of the centre and lower frame, its body facing somewhat forward while its head turns decisively towards the left. At the upper left, the long beak projects almost to the border, its upper ridge catching a narrow pale highlight. The beak is dark horn-grey rather than pure black, with a smooth hard surface contrasting against the surrounding feathers. Near the centre-left, one glossy black eye reflects a tiny bright point, giving the otherwise sombre face a concentrated sense of alertness. Around it, fine feathers lie close to the skull in cool blue-grey and charcoal strokes. Above the brow, a small antique-gold crown rests at a slight angle, its base following the curve of the head. The crown has raised leaf-like points, dark recesses and small ornamental shapes, with a worn metallic surface rather than an evenly polished shine. Its highest points approach the top edge, while the right side sinks slightly into the dark plumage. Below the cheek, longer throat feathers separate into soft narrow strands, some highlighted with muted silver-grey. Across the lower centre, the breast and shoulder form a broad rounded mass, with overlapping feather groups painted in deep blue-black, smoky brown and subdued slate. On the right, the wing and body dissolve gradually into shadow rather than ending in a sharply cut contour. The lower edge crops the bird before the legs or perch are visible, keeping the image a close portrait. Small rubbed areas and fine scratch-like paint marks pass over the background and the darkest feathers, contributing to the aged surface. The lighting is soft from the upper left, catching the crown, beak ridge, eye and selected feather edges while leaving the right side of the body dark. The crown remains a material object placed on the head, even though the pairing creates a gently fantastical subject. The overall composition balances a strong left-facing profile and compact gilded accent against a quiet weathered field, combining solemn animal portraiture, muted earth colours and tactile old-paint texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画感肖像，一只黑色渡鸦戴着装饰金冠，背景为旧橄榄棕色。背景像浅而接近平面的墙，带斑驳污痕、细淡竖纹和不均匀暖灰色块。上方暗色区域衬托王冠参差尖端。鸟占据中央和下方大部分画面，身体略朝前，头明确转向左方。左上长喙几乎伸至边界，上脊有一条窄浅高光。喙是深角质灰而非纯黑，平滑坚硬表面与羽毛相对照。中间偏左，一只光亮黑眼映出极小亮点，使沉暗面孔显得警觉。眼周细羽贴着头骨，以冷蓝灰和炭灰笔触表现。额头上方，小古金王冠略微倾斜，底部顺着头部弧度。王冠有叶状突起、深凹槽与小装饰形，金属表面旧化，并不是均匀抛光。最高尖端靠近上沿，右侧略沉入暗羽。脸颊下方较长喉羽分成柔软细束，部分带暗银灰亮边。下方中央胸肩形成宽阔圆体，层叠羽群以深蓝黑、烟棕和暗石板色绘出。右侧翅身渐渐融入阴影，没有一刀切般硬轮廓。下沿在腿和栖架出现前裁切身体，使画面保持近距离肖像。背景和最暗羽毛上有小片磨擦痕及细刮线，加强古旧画面表层。光从左上方柔和照来，挑亮王冠、喙脊、眼睛和少量羽缘，右侧身体保持暗。虽然戴冠组合使主题带轻微幻想意味，王冠仍像真实放置在头上的物体。整体以强烈左向侧面和紧凑金色点缀平衡安静旧墙色面，融合庄重动物肖像、低饱和土色和可触的旧颜料质感。
style_prompt_en: The painterly treatment combines close observation of rounded form with an aged, shallow background. Blue-black and charcoal passages carry restrained silver-grey highlights, while small antique-gold accents provide concentrated warmth. Fine directional strokes follow surface growth and overlap in layered groups rather than forming uniform noise. Smooth hard edges contrast with soft, frayed boundaries that dissolve into the surrounding umber. Gentle upper-side light reveals selected contours and leaves substantial shadow intact. Mottled stains and faint scratches unify the surface. The overall effect is solemn and tactile, with compact framing, subdued colour and a quietly fantastical decorative accent.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画处理将对圆润体积的细致观察与古旧浅背景结合。蓝黑和炭灰中带克制银灰亮部，小面积古金色集中提供暖意。细方向性笔触沿表面生长方向排列，以成组重叠形成纹理，而非均匀噪点。平滑硬边与融入深褐环境的松软毛边对照。上侧柔光只揭示部分轮廓，大块阴影仍完整保留。斑驳污痕和细刮纹统一整个表面。整体庄重可触，取景紧凑，色彩低调，并有安静幻想感的装饰点缀。
theme_en: A crowned raven against an aged wall
theme_zh: 古旧墙面前戴金冠的渡鸦
name: Carel Fabritius
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
